description: We are a passionate,  team of CSE  students participating in the NASA Hackathon. Our interests include space technology,AI,healthcare innovation and software development. We are developing CosmoCare,an astronaut health-monitoring solution focused on tracking vital signs such as heart rate, ECG and SpO₂ through an interactive dashboard. We welcome creative, collaborative members skilled in AI/ML, programming,UI/UX, and data analysis who are eager to solve real-world challenges through innovation.
summary:
**Cosmo Care – Astronaut Health Monitoring System**

Cosmo Care is a web-based astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support crew health and safety during space missions. It brings multiple health and environmental monitoring modules together in a single, user-friendly dashboard. The platform includes Cardiovascular Monitoring, Blood Oxygen Monitoring, Sleep Tracking, Bone Health Monitoring, Radiation Monitoring, Air Quality Monitoring, Balance and Movement Analysis, Family Connect, and Alerts and Warnings.

Cosmo Care aims to help monitor important health indicators, identify potential risks, and present relevant information through visual dashboards, charts, and alert notifications. Its environmental monitoring module focuses on cabin conditions such as carbon dioxide, temperature, and humidity, while its health modules address the challenges associated with microgravity and long-duration spaceflight.

The Family Connect module supports communication through authenticated messaging. NASA research and datasets provide the scientific foundation for relevant monitoring concepts. The platform is developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Supabase, and Chart.js, with simulated readings clearly distinguished from actual astronaut measurements.
details:
Cosmo Care is an astronaut health monitoring prototype designed to support crew health and safety during space missions.

It brings multiple health and environmental monitoring concepts into one dashboard, including cardiovascular health, blood oxygen, sleep, bone health, radiation, cabin air quality, balance and movement, alerts, and Family Connect.

The platform helps astronauts understand important health indicators, recognize potential risks, and stay connected with their families. It uses interactive dashboards, visual indicators, animations, and alert notifications to present information clearly.

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chart.js, Font Awesome, Google Fonts, Supabase, Gmail integration, and GitHub Pages.

Our project is based on NASA research resources, including NASA's Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), GeneLab, and NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS).

The current version is a software prototype using simulated readings; live sensor and telemetry integration is a future development goal. No physical hardware is currently connected.

Our aim is to contribute to astronaut health awareness, support safer long-duration missions, and demonstrate how an integrated digital platform could help monitor crew well-being in space.
